shortDescription: Eva Airways Corp. is considering ordering about two dozen large passenger jets from Airbus SE and Boeing Co. as it modernizes and expands its fleet, according to people familiar with the matter, Bloomberg reported.

title: Eva Air Considers About Two Dozen Airbus, Boeing Widebody Jets
